args: 2025 Revenue Reconciliation via Correct Ledger Accounts, by Quarter
Using the right ledger accounts (revenue credits net of refund contra-revenue debits), does the ledger's net revenue tie to the payments table's net captured amount each quarter?

Separately, payments filtered to captured_at in 2025 with the usual status filter, converting amount and amount_refunded to EUR via exchange_rates on captured_at. Group both sides by calendar quarter and join on quarter. diff_eur = ledger_net_revenue_eur - payments_net_amount_eur; diff_pct = diff_eur / payments_net_amount_eur * 100. Order chronologically 2025-Q1 to 2025-Q4 (4 rows).", "builds_on": ["Ledger Line-Item Detail for Flagged Sample Payments, 2025", "Ledger-to-Payment Reconciliation Pattern at Scale, 2025"]}
